Predicted ~0.1 alpha.
prereg.gray_band_rule_added_before_run: 0.01 <= ratio <= 0.1: the design gives no branch; reported GRAY, neither branch fires (recommendation only: the stricter one).
prereg.agent_prediction_run_A: cfl_timestep uses the parcels' MATERIAL sound speed (iron 5942 m/s), not c_s = 0.046 m/s, so dt_cfl = 0.153 s and 100 steps cover ~15 s = 3e-4 t_ff: the cloud has barely moved. Continuum estimate ratio ~ alpha*k*h/(2 c_s) with homologous k = (GM/R^3) t => ratio(alpha=1, step 50) ~ 1e-4 (ALLOW branch, but an artefact of the time step); step 0 ratio = 0 exactly (cold start, v = 0); alpha-slope = 1.000 by construction (Pi is linear in alpha at an alpha-independent state); h-slope ~ 1.
prereg.agent_prediction_run_B: dt = t_ff/600: ratio(alpha=1) ~ 0.84 (t/t_ff) early -> ~0.07 at step 50 (GRAY), crosses 0.1 near 0.12 t_ff, reaches O(1) late in the collapse; alpha-slope falls below 0.85 late (viscosity slows the infall); h-slope ~ 1 +- 0.3 early.
